task.title: View and Search Appointments
task.shortdesc: Review future appointments and use the appointment search screen to locate an appointment.

taskbody.context: Use the appointment area to review scheduled appointments and narrow the list when you need to find a specific appointment.

step.cmd: Open the appointment search function when you need to locate a specific appointment.
Enter the available search criteria and run the search.

taskbody.result: The system displays appointments that match the search criteria.
